title: Band Capricio Live Music In Houston
description: An Enchanting Evening with Band Capricio Live in Houston
long_description:
An Enchanting Evening with Band Capricio Live in Houston
Mark your calendars for the 24th of October, 2026, as Band Capricio is set to create a magical evening with their live music performance in Houston. Famous for their fusion of different genres, this classical Telugu band will blend melodies that will take you on a melodious journey. Get ready for the intermingling of Telugu and Hindi tunes as you enjoy a live concert of soulful singing and invigorating music.
Meet the Maestros - Band Capricio
Introducing Band Capricio, a classical fusion Telugu band, known for their unique ability to blend diverse genres of melodies. Their music is not just a performance, but an experience that transcends boundaries, creating a sensory feast for the audience. With a musical prowess that resonates with people of all ages, Band Capricio is sure to enthrall you with their unique mix of Telugu and Hindi melodies.
The Perfect Backdrop - Park 8 Event Center
The live performance of Band Capricio is set to happen at the Park 8 Event Center, located at 8800 W Sam Pkwy S, Houston, TX, United States. Known for its excellent safety measures and accessibility, this venue stands out as the perfect setting for the concert. The center is surrounded by a host of attractions and offers ample parking. Enhance your experience with a pre or post-concert meal at any of the nearby Indian restaurants, adding an authentic flavor to your evening.
Grab Your Tickets Now!
Don't miss out on the opportunity to witness Band Capricio live. Tickets are now available for purchase. Opt for an Early Bird ticket priced at $22.99, or splurge on the Early bird VIP ticket priced at $59.99 for an exclusive experience. For those wanting to enjoy the concert with friends or family, the VVIP Table for 8 is available at $750.00. Secure your spot now and be a part of this enchanting musical journey.
